LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we join sentences correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences

What this means
In this part you learn to use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles to a partner. (skill: use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words.
3. Practise this skill: use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we join sentences correctly?
2. Why do we use conjunctions?
3. How can one join two or more sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words.
5. Be able to: use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
